title: Tool audit entry (the agent's AuditEntry)
description: PROVISIONAL. The line `executeGuardedTool` hands to its audit sink. `decision` is a French, user-facing literal today and is expected to change when the journal is internationalised; `args` is masked (`redactText`) before it is cut. Closed field set: no token, no capability.

args.description:
JSON of the arguments, masked then cut at 500 characters; a cut value ends with the marker `
… [tronqué, N caractères de plus]`, so the bound is 500 plus the marker (measured: 537 for a 5000-character argument).
